candidates.change_summary: Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so the parameter is ignored.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(this);` to set owner to the contract's address.
Delete the assignment `owner = _owner;` so owner never changes.
Delete the `require` statement in the modifier, allowing anyone to call setOwner.
Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so the function succeeds but returns false instead of true.
Delete 'return true;' so the function silently returns the default bool value false.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so anyone can call it.
Set owner to msg.sender instead of _owner, ignoring the argument.
Change the onlyAdmin modifier to check msg.sender == owner instead of admin.
